name: terraform-skill
title_zh: 写 Terraform 时自动识别故障模式并给出版本
tagline_zh: 当你的 module 开始身份漂移、密钥泄漏、爆炸半径失控时，它不报错，而是告诉你这是哪一类故障、该往哪儿修。
tagline_en: When your module starts identity churn, secret leaks, or blast-radius creep, it names the failure mode and points.
desc_en: Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging Terraform/OpenTofu modules, tests, CI, scans, or state ops - diagnoses failure mode (identity churn, secrets, blast radius, CI drift, state corruption) with version-aware guards.
why_zh: 不是 lint，是诊断器：按故障模式分类（身份漂移、密钥、爆炸半径、CI 漂移、状态损坏）。
why_en: Not a linter but a diagnostician: classifies failures by mode (identity churn, secrets, blast radius, CI drift, state.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Terraform/OpenTofu 的 module 编写、测试、CI、扫描和状态操作。
limit_en: Only for Terraform/OpenTofu modules, tests, CI, scans, state ops. Non-HCL IaC (Pulumi, CloudFormation) unsupported; non-modular code gets generic.
